thread:
Ethan: FYI console shows /v1/generate on canary at 10% but traces indicate certain cohorts see canary ~70% of the time.
Maya: :thinking: did we change cookie naming or hash seed recently?
Ethan: Rotated cookie domain last week (privacy), and I merged a seed selection change yesterday (seed_source: header_fallback -> header_priority). Suspect an interaction.
Ravi: Paste the rollout config (sanitized) and which guard mode is on (sticky/stateless).
Ethan: rollout snippet:
```
rollout: {
  strategy: "traffic_split",
  splits: [{variant: "stable", pct: 90}, {variant: "canary", pct: 10}],
  hash_key: "session_id||x-client-id||request.cookie:rw_session",
  sticky: true,
  seed_rotation: "daily",
  header_priority: ["x-priority-route", "x-client-id"]
}
```
Jordan: Note that seed_rotation=daily + sticky=true means expired/missing cookies will get reseeded often. Changing cookie domain can make many clients stop sending old cookie -> hashing falls back to headers. If a header is low-cardinality (SDK version) you get skew.
Maya: Traces show a hotspot: client-id `sdk-android-2.1.4` is overrepresented and hitting canary a lot. Could be the Android SDK sending a constant header value.
Ana: Can we roll back the seed change safely? We need to stop large user cohorts hitting canary.
Ravi: Quick mitigation: disable seed_rotation (set to none) and add a guard to prefer cookie when present (no header-only routing). Also temporarily reduce canary pct to 5%.
Ethan: Pushing patch now. PR: https://git.internal/r/rollouts/123
deploy-bot: deployment started for rollout/123 by Ethan — canary reduced to 5% until we confirm.
Maya: Add sampling to log hash inputs + decision (obfuscated ids) for about 0.1% of traffic so we can confirm the inputs causing skew.
Ravi: Also add a short-lived alert: if observed split deviates >15% from configured in any 5m window -> page eng-platform.
Ethan: Sampling + alert added. Patch pushed and config rolled.
Maya: Early results: overall canary impressions down to ~6%. The sdk-android cluster now aligns to expected ~11-13% of its cohort.
Jordan: Follow-ups: improve console to show split histogram by top N client-ids/cookies, warn in rollout editor when seed_rotation != none && sticky == true && header_priority not empty, and document pitfalls when changing cookie domains.
Ana: Please add a short blurb to release notes and customer-facing changelog; some customers reported unexpected model regen rates.
Ethan: Filing RCA ticket: https://tasks.internal/PM-456
Maya: Also filing infra task to rate-limit header fallback inputs for hashing decisions (avoid pathological concentration).
Ravi: Closing loop once postmortem + console guard are done. Thanks all :thumbsup:
